C0171.title: Blocking Web Page Elements with the AdGuard Browser Extension
C0171.summary: In December 2024, a tutorial detailed how to use the AdGuard browser extension to block web page elements, including ads and unwanted content. The case demonstrated specific operations such as removing the search pop-up when selecting text on CSDN, and blocking collection prompts and login pop-ups on Juejin, illustrating the practical application of ad-blocking plugins.
